I have a little bit of skill when it comes to copying an image in front of me (not tracing, but actually redrawing it). However, I would like to be able to draw from scratch so to say. Thanks for any advice!

I'm not really good, I'm pretty new to this myself. I also found myself in the same situation, but this video helped me out a bit: http://youtu.be/oKFfSl-EBfI

And then, watch his drawing method videos found in this playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL0373FA2B3CD4C899

And then, keep on going from there. Watching tutorials, repeat, grasp it, comprehend it, master it.

If you can't figure out what to do, pick something simple to work with and just keep hacking away at it. Learning art is like learning anything else, learn the simple things before you learn the more complex things. So, work on fundamental tutorials, then work with more complex things.
Look at art for inspiration. Start small
